stem.text: The diagrams show the shape and size of two types of cell.

stem.alt: Drawing of a palisade mesophyll cell labelled surface area = 2200 µm2, with dimensions 10 µm, 10 µm and 50 µm.
stem.label: palisade mesophyll cell

stem.alt: Drawing of a columnar epithelial cell labelled volume = 2250 µm3, with dimensions 10 µm, 5 µm and 45 µm; marked not to scale.
stem.label: columnar epithelial cell

stem.text: Which statement about the palisade cell and epithelial cell shown in the diagrams is correct?

A.text: An increase in surface area reduces the distance for gases to reach the centre of the cell.

B.text: The surface area of the palisade mesophyll cell is $500\,\mu\text{m}^{2}$ greater than the columnar epithelial cell.

C.text: The surface area to volume ratio is greater in the columnar epithelial cell than the palisade mesophyll cell.

D.text: The volume of the palisade mesophyll cell is $2500\,\mu\text{m}^{3}$ greater than that of the columnar epithelial cell.
